title: FileDialog makes it impossible to open a folder on web with touch input
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in (built with and on): - Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.5597) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900H (20 threads) - 31.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) - Godot v4.7.1.stable (a13da4feb) - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:51:19 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (nvidia; 610.57.04) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 31.07 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### System information For build machines see above, the actual issue was tested on Firefox and Chrome on a Pixel 10, Pixel 7 and Samsung S25, you can also try it if you emulate touch input in developer tools on desktop. ### Issue description When you open a FileDialog on web mobile (using touch as input), it is impossible to open a folder. When you tap on it, it just highlights like shown in the picture. Double clicking and long pressing doesn't do anything. ### Steps to reproduce - Create a FileDialog (non-native, although I believe it is actually impossible to open a native dialog on web) - Try to open a folder - Observe it not working ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Open it run on web (with touch input, so browser web tools or mobile) and try to open the .godot folder. [mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30919011/mrp.zip)
